seo.title: Gym management software — memberships, check-in and billing
seo.description: Nexus Gym runs your club's front desk: memberships, check-in, payments, classes and reports — and keeps working when the internet does not.

hero.title: Run your gym from one screen, even when the internet is down.
hero.lead: Memberships, check-in, payments, classes and owner reports in one desktop application, built for clubs and studios.
bullets: Works offline at the front desk
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like a demo of Nexus Gym.

items.question: Does it need internet?
items.answer: No. The front desk works on a local database; internet is only needed for updates and optional backups.

items.question: Can you import our current members?
items.answer: Yes. We import members and subscriptions from your spreadsheets or previous system.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Licensing depends on the number of branches and workstations. Book a demo and we will send a quote.
